# Psalm 24 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Of-David. A-psalm. To-YHWH [belongs] the-earth and-its-fullness, the-world and-those-who-dwell in-it.

**2** For He upon the-seas has-founded-it, and-upon the-rivers He-establishes-it.

**3** Who shall-ascend the-mountain of-YHWH? And-who shall-stand in-His-holy place?

**4** The-clean of-hands and-pure of-heart, who has-not lifted-up his-soul to-falsehood, and-has-not sworn deceitfully.

**5** He-shall-receive blessing from YHWH, and-righteousness from-the-God of-his-salvation.

**6** This [is] the-generation of-those-seeking-Him, those-seeking Your-face — Jacob. Selah.

**7** Lift-up, O-gates, your-heads, and-be-lifted-up, O-ancient doors, and-let-come-in the-King of-glory.

**8** Who [is] this King of-glory? YHWH strong and-mighty, YHWH mighty in-battle.

**9** Lift-up, O-gates, your-heads, and-lift-up, O-ancient doors, and-let-come-in the-King of-glory.

**10** Who [is] He, this King of-glory? YHWH of-hosts — He [is] the-King of-glory. Selah.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **24:7-10**: An antiphonal liturgy — two voices alternate. 'Who is this King of glory?' may have been the gatekeeper's challenge as the Ark entered Jerusalem.

— EMET
